summary: The root لحي (lHy) primarily refers to the jawbone and, by extension, the beard. It can also describe the act of shaving or trimming the beard, or striking someone on the jaw.

provenance.lane: Edward William Lane, An Arabic-English Lexicon (1863-93), public domain. Digital text via Perseus, Tufts University, CC BY-SA 3.0 US.
provenance.summary: Editorial summary derived from the Lane entry. NOT Lane's own wording. Shown as a gloss only; the Lane text below is the source.

headwords.def: لُحِىَ : see a verse cited voce خَطَبَ . لَحَاهُ ٱللّٰهُ : see شَرَاهُ .

headwords.gloss: He wound a part of his turban under his lower jaw

parts.t: He wound a part of his turban under his lower jaw:

headwords.def: تَلَحَّى , (S, Mgh,) and تلحّى بِعِمَامَتِهِ , (TA, art. عجر ,) He wound a part of his turban under his lower jaw: (S, Mgh:) as also تَحَنَّكَ , q. v.

headwords.gloss: I peeled off the flesh from the bone

parts.t: I peeled off the flesh from the bone

headwords.def: اِلْتَحَيْتُ اللَّحْمَ عَنِ العَظْمِ [ I peeled off the flesh from the bone ]. (O, K, in art. سلق .)

headwords.gloss: jaw-bone; upper or lower; part on which the beard grows

parts.t: part on which the beard grows.
Either lateral portion of the lower jaw:

headwords.def: لَحْىٌ [not لَحًى ] The jaw-bone; (Mgh, Msb;) either upper or lower: (Msb:) and, in a man, (Msb,) the part on which the beard grows. (S, Msb, K.) And sometimes Either lateral portion of the lower jaw: see َقَنٌ , and الفَنِيكُ .

parts.t: is sometimes, by a synecdoche, put for the whole

headwords.def: لِحْيَةُ التَّيْسِ : see ثِيلٌ . لِحْيَةٌ is sometimes, by a synecdoche, put for the whole person: see a verse cited voce خُنْثٌ .

headwords.gloss: Bark; bark; of which ropes &c. are made

parts.t: of a plant, or of a tree,

headwords.def: لِحَآءٌ Bark; and in particular the bark of a plant, or of a tree, of which ropes &c. are made. The لِحَآء of the date is [its Pulp, pulpy pericarp, or flesh; i. e.] the part that clothes the نَوَاة [or stone ]. (TA.) لِحَآءُ العِنَبِ [ The skin of grapes ]. (TA in art. شحم .)
لَوَاحِى الشَّيْبِ , for لَوَائِحُ الشيب , q. v.

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
